title: Hearing the Unspoken: Language Model Priors for Acoustic Adversarial Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2606.06833v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems operating in real-time settings must process acoustic input under strict temporal constraints, where transcription decisions are inherently made on incomplete information. This causal constraint serves as an information bottleneck on attackers, significantly limiting attack performance. Our new Semantic Gambit attack breaks this causal limitation by augmenting the adversary with predictive context derived from a Large Language Model in real-time. Our experiments show that this form of augmentation can elevate the corpus-level Word Error Rate to 35.6% -- a three-fold increase over the current state-of-the-art. Ultimately, this work reveals how common, low-latency LLM tooling can be exploited to systematically subvert real-time ASR pipelines.

translated_title: 听到未言说之事：用于声学对抗攻击的语言模型先验
translated_abstract: 在实时环境下运行的自动语音识别（ASR）系统必须在严格的时间约束下处理声学输入，其转录决策本质上是在不完整信息的基础上做出的。这种因果约束构成了攻击者面临的信息瓶颈，显著限制了攻击性能。我们提出的新型Semantic Gambit攻击通过实时利用大语言模型提供的预测性上下文来增强攻击者，从而打破了这一因果限制。实验表明，这种增强方式可以将语料库级别的词错误率（WER）提升至35.6%——相比当前最先进水平提高了三倍。这项工作最终揭示了常见的低延迟大语言模型工具如何可能被利用来系统性地颠覆实时ASR流程。
tldr: 该论文提出Semantic Gambit攻击方法，通过实时利用大语言模型的预测性上下文突破实时ASR系统的因果信息瓶颈，将语料库级词错误率提升至35.6%，达到现有最先进攻击方法的三倍水平。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Semantic Gambit attack, which breaks the causal information bottleneck of real-time ASR systems by leveraging real-time predictive context from Large Language Models, elevating corpus-level Word Error Rate to 35.6% — a three-fold improvement over the current state-of-the-art.
